invariants: A clear waiting_async flag selects SDK postMessage mailbox delivery, including pthread cancellation and reuse.
ProxyingQueue.queue identifies the public C queue executed by emscripten_proxy_execute_queue on its target thread.
Async proxy submission publishes work before notifying; duplicate notifications can observe an empty queue.
The SQL control Worker stays live until replies are delivered; the I/O owner drains independently through its direct channel.
